parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific bug but introduces a potential issue with handling non-finite values.

issues.description: The change introduces a potential behavioral regression risk by returning `None` when all values are non-finite, which may break existing code that assumes a value will always be returned.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the behavior of `_safe_first_finite` with various non-finite inputs, which is crucial for ensuring the fix is robust.
